method: Reviewed the OpenAI Agents SDK official product overview for its own SDK-versus-Responses-API guidance. Reworked the lesson into a hard-gate and weighted-preference matrix, scoped migration estimates to representative changeover rehearsals, and narrowed the AST example to direct imported type names in sync/async signatures. Ran the complete Python 3.10.9 fixture and exact stdout comparison; no provider or network calls were made.
limitations: The AST checker is a local heuristic. It does not resolve indirect exports, string forward references, runtime objects, function bodies, serialized data, or other languages.
The OpenAI documentation describes OpenAI products only; no comparative framework benchmark was conducted.
The historical LangChain 0.3.7 schema comparison and 0/3 versus 3/3 model outcomes were not rerun; total migration cost, provider acceptance, and production recovery remain unverified.
